name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-grafana
description: Search & edit Grafana dashboards, query datasources (PromQL/LogQL/SQL), inspect alerts.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Grafana instance (e.g. http://localhost:3000).

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Grafana service-account token (Bearer). Use a Viewer-role account for read-only use.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; writes need read-write.
